name: rightsizer_agent
description: SRE agent that finds underutilized nodes and over-requested Kubernetes workloads, and recommends right-sizing and consolidation. Read-only.

skills.name: Detect Underutilized Nodes
skills.description: Find nodes with low CPU/memory utilization relative to capacity and recommend candidates for consolidation (cordon/drain).
examples: Find nodes I can drain to save cost.

skills.name: Detect Over-Requested Workloads
skills.description: Find pods and deployments whose resource requests greatly exceed actual usage and recommend right-sized requests.
examples: Suggest right-sized CPU requests for my deployments.
